{{Quote|Bossk-- his hands! They're chained to the wheel!|The alien bounty hunter, duped by Boba Fett|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire 6">[[Shadows of the Empire 6|''Shadows of the Empire'' 6]]</ref>}}
A '''pink-skinned alien''' who worked as a bounty hunter, teamed up with a group of fellow [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] led by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in late [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] in a last-ditch effort to steal away the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-frozen [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from the hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] before Fett could deliver Solo to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and claim the corresponding [[Bounty/Legends|reward]]. However, Fett duped his assailants into believing he was transporting Solo's carbonite slab into [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] aboard a [[Hoversled/Legends|hoversled]], which was a diversion that allowed him to sneak into the palace unmolested. In the aftermath of that chase, after Bossk had downed the runaway [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot, this hunter pointed out that "Fett," whom Bossk was prepared to [[Death/Legends|kill]], was actually a [[Zuckuss/Legends|decoy]].
